scientific_integrity: The six-right-vertex threshold itself is known; this result claims the exact DP-color-function counts for the pre-threshold cases. Independent mathematical audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Three-fold covers only, on K_{3,n}. Finite cases n=1..6 use an exhaustive finite integer certificate supplemented by a symbolic all-n obstruction. This work does not determine higher-palette counts, all minimizing-cover isomorphism classes, or historical priority beyond inspected sources.
title: Exact three-colour correspondence-colouring function of \(K_{3,n}\)
